description:
FILED s531a (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-01) from #1688 acceptance (TT compile2.t row 9 after require started answering the file value).  PRE-EXISTING design trade-off, now visible.

p-cache-valid-p (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp) calls an entry valid when the cache file is NEWER than the source (%p-mtime) and the dependency manifest still hashes; the SOURCE itself is never hashed.  t/compile2.t reads t/test/src/foo.ttc, rewrites "the foo file" -> "the hacked foo file", restores the old atime/mtime with utime, and then `require`s it through Template::Provider: perl reads the new text, PCL loads the module cache entry built from the OLD text ("This is the foo file, a is any value" where perl prints "hacked").

REPRO (perl 5.40.3): write lib/Hk.pm = `package Hk; sub v {"old"} 1;`, run `perl -Ilib -MHk -e print Hk::v()` under ./pcl once (builds the entry), then rewrite the file to `sub v {"new"}` keeping its mtime (`my @t=(stat $f)[8,9]; ...write...; utime @t, $f`) and run again: perl new, PCL old.

FIX SHAPE (a cache-validity decision, ir-spec 9.2b): also key on the source SIZE (cheap, catches this TT case) or a content hash (#1261 already hashes dependencies; the cost is one read of each module per load).  Measure the load-path cost first.  Board row: Template-Toolkit compile2.t 9 (blessed to this task by s531a).

=== DONE (s532d) ===
BUILT AS RULED (s532): the dependency manifest records the SOURCE's byte size (a `size<TAB>BYTES` line, Pl/ProtoCache.pm write_deps_file; a string eval's manifest names itself as the source and records none), and p-cache-valid-p requires the size now == the recorded size, beside the mtime test, from the SAME stat (%p-mtime-and-size: one sb-posix:stat, mtime + 2208988800 = file-write-date, probed).  A module or script manifest with no `size` line is invalid (re-transpiled once).  Generation v2-11900 (the manifest format changed: a main-tree runtime would reject a `size` line as an unknown key and ping-pong on the shared cache) + the three artifacts regenerated (stamp line only).  docs/not-supported.md ns-cache-same-size-rewrite: a same-size same-mtime rewrite is not seen; the full source hash is NOT built.  ir-spec 9.2b clause 1 + the manifest form.
GUARD: Pl/t/module-fasl-cache-01.t rows 22-25 (a rewrite with the old mtime RESTORED by utime and a different length is re-transpiled: the fasl path and the text path), inverse-verified on 06a4b8ba.  The cache tests cache-surface / cache-validity / eval-cache / manifest / script-cache pass.
ACCEPTANCE: TT compile2.t row 9 had a FIRST cause in front of this one -- `utime(@current_times, $compiled)` with the times in an ARRAY set nothing under PCL (#4321, filed + fixed in the same commit), so Template::Provider saw a newer .ttc and recompiled from source.  With both: one-file runs compile1 -> compile2 (pass=14 fail=1: row 15 = NS caller fidelity, stays) and compile4 -> compile5 (pass=13 fail=1: row 14 stays); compile2.t 9 and compile5.t 8 12 LEFT baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit.
BENCH (warm start-up, heavy.sh s532d bench 03:07-03:11, load 1.7-2.0; scratch/s532d/out/bench4165.log; base 06a4b8ba pcl vs tree pcl, best-of-5 interleaved after warm-up):
    scratch/s532d/pr/many.pl (69 modules)   before 0.809 s   after 0.801 s   (-1.1 %)
    everyday/modules/JSON-PP.pl              before 0.213 s   after 0.209 s   (-1.5 %)
    everyday/modules/Archive-Tar-Compress.pl before 0.586 s   after 0.581 s   (-0.7 %)
  -> no move (the stat was already taken; the size comes from it).


=== COMPLETED (s536, reviewing session, 2026-11-08) === merged as MAIN-READY-75 33334fb1 (s532d); review probes perl -> main 0affbe86 -> tree (scratchpad p532d/a.pl): tree = perl; no live baseline row keys on this task (CLOSE-WITH-ROWS checked).
subject: The module cache trusts the source file MTIME: a file rewritten with its old mtime restored (utime) is served from the stale compile -- Template Toolkit compile2.t hacks a compiled .ttc and expects the hacked text
